system.description: You harness your mystic source to instantly transport yourself to a new location you can see within long range. If you appear within immediate range of a foe, you can make one unarmed attack against them as an extra action. Effort: Reach a location within range that you can't see directly because it's blocked by a wall or structure. First action. If you try to use Mystic Step to reach a location that has no room for you, the ability automatically fails and you don't leave your original location.
